sentences.text:
For the Respondents: Mr. Ashish Kr. Thakur, A.C to A.A.G-III  -----
04/18.01.2023 The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upo concerned respondents to consider the petitioner's claim and pay compensation to him in lieu of acquisition of his land appertaining to Plot Nos. 119, 125, 156 & 123, under Jamabandi No. 7,
corresponding to current settlement Jamabandi No. 4, Mouza-Jamua, P.S-Saraiyahat,
District-Dumka, measuring total area of 1.54 Acres for construction of new Mohanpur Hansdiha BG Railway Line.

Mr. Ashish Kr. Thakur, learned A.C to A.A.G-III appearing on behalf of the respondents, refers to the counter affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent Nos. 2 & 3 and submits that the respondent No.3 considering that there is a dispute of apportionment of compensation amount amongst the petitioner, Anuplal Yadav and others, has referred the matter to the Principal District Judge-cum-Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, Dumka vide memo No. 36 dated 23.12.2021 under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act, 2013').
